```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(randomForest)
library(zoo)
library(lubridate)
library(purrr)

set.seed(42)

predictors <- c("Tair", "SW_rad", "VPD", "cumulative_cwd_7day")
extreme_magnitude_increase <- 1.28

# Remove unwanted sites before running
sites_daily <- sites_daily[!names(sites_daily) %in%
  c("Emr", "Wac", "Ync")]

# ── Aridity index site groupings ──────────────────────────────────────────────
humid_sites <- c("Fog", "How", "Tum", "Wom")
dry_subhumid_sites <- c("Ade", "Cum", "Dap")
semi_arid_sites <- c("Boy", "Das", "Dry", "Gin", "Rdf", "Rig", "Stp", "Whr")
arid_sites <- c("Asm")

# ── Aridity-index-specific VPD shifts ────────────────────────────────────────
aridity_vpd_shift <- c(
  humid = 0.255,
  dry_subhumid = 0.340,
  semi_arid = 0.4675,
  arid = 0.680
)
```

```{r}
prepare_site_envelope <- function(df, site_name) {

  df <- df %>%
    drop_na(GPP, Tair, SW_rad, VPD, cwd, date) %>%
    arrange(date) %>%
    mutate(
      year = year(date),
      cumulative_cwd_7day = rollapply(
        cwd,
        width = 7,
        FUN = sum,
        align = "right",
        fill = NA,
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
    ) %>%
    drop_na(all_of(predictors), GPP)

  if (nrow(df) < 100) {
    message("Skipping ", site_name, ": insufficient data")
    return(NULL)
  }

  message("Prepared ", site_name, ": ", nrow(df), " rows")
  df
}
```

```{r}
run_future_envelope <- function(df, site_name) {

  message("Running future envelope: ", site_name)

  vpd_shift <- case_when(
    site_name %in% humid_sites ~ aridity_vpd_shift["humid"],
    site_name %in% dry_subhumid_sites ~ aridity_vpd_shift["dry_subhumid"],
    site_name %in% semi_arid_sites ~ aridity_vpd_shift["semi_arid"],
    site_name %in% arid_sites ~ aridity_vpd_shift["arid"],
    TRUE ~ NA_real_
  )

  if (is.na(vpd_shift)) {
    warning(site_name, " not assigned to an aridity class — skipping")
    return(NULL)
  }

  # Pull site-specific threshold from sensitivity analysis
  vpd_peak <- site_slopes %>%
    filter(site == site_name) %>%
    pull(vpd_at_peak)

  if (length(vpd_peak) == 0 || is.na(vpd_peak)) {
    warning(site_name, " missing vpd_at_peak — skipping")
    return(NULL)
  }

  # Train RF once on observed data
  formula <- as.formula(paste("GPP ~", paste(predictors, collapse = " + ")))
  mtry_val <- max(2, floor(sqrt(length(predictors))))

  rf_model <- randomForest(
    formula,
    data = df,
    ntree = 500,
    mtry = mtry_val,
    importance = FALSE
  )

  # Scenario 1: mean shift only
  df_s1 <- df %>%
    mutate(VPD = VPD + vpd_shift)

  # Scenario 2: +28% increase above site-specific VPD threshold
  df_s2 <- df %>%
    mutate(
      VPD = ifelse(
        VPD >= vpd_peak,
        VPD * extreme_magnitude_increase,
        VPD
      )
    )

  # Scenario 3: combined scenario
  vpd_peak_shifted <- vpd_peak + vpd_shift

  df_s3 <- df %>%
    mutate(
      VPD = VPD + vpd_shift,
      VPD = ifelse(
        VPD >= vpd_peak_shifted,
        VPD * extreme_magnitude_increase,
        VPD
      )
    )

  # Predictions
  GPP_baseline <- predict(rf_model, df)
  GPP_s1 <- predict(rf_model, df_s1)
  GPP_s2 <- predict(rf_model, df_s2)
  GPP_s3 <- predict(rf_model, df_s3)

  df %>%
    mutate(
      site = site_name,
      aridity_class = case_when(
        site_name %in% humid_sites ~ "Humid",
        site_name %in% dry_subhumid_sites ~ "Dry sub-humid",
        site_name %in% semi_arid_sites ~ "Semi-Arid",
        site_name %in% arid_sites ~ "Arid"
      ),
      vpd_shift = vpd_shift,
      vpd_peak_threshold = vpd_peak,
      vpd_peak_shifted = vpd_peak_shifted,

      GPP_obs = GPP,
      GPP_baseline = GPP_baseline,
      GPP_s1 = GPP_s1,
      GPP_s2 = GPP_s2,
      GPP_s3 = GPP_s3,

      delta_s1_abs = GPP_s1 - GPP_baseline,
      delta_s2_abs = GPP_s2 - GPP_baseline,
      delta_s3_abs = GPP_s3 - GPP_baseline,

      delta_s1_pct = (delta_s1_abs / GPP_baseline) * 100,
      delta_s2_pct = (delta_s2_abs / GPP_baseline) * 100,
      delta_s3_pct = (delta_s3_abs / GPP_baseline) * 100
    )
}
```

```{r}
prepared_envelope <- map2(
  sites_daily,
  names(sites_daily),
  prepare_site_envelope
)

prepared_envelope <- Filter(Negate(is.null), prepared_envelope)

envelope_results <- map2_dfr(
  prepared_envelope,
  names(prepared_envelope),
  run_future_envelope
)

message("\nSites completed: ", n_distinct(envelope_results$site))
```

```{r}
annual_summary <- envelope_results %>%
  group_by(site, aridity_class, year) %>%
  summarise(
    GPP_baseline_annual = sum(GPP_baseline, na.rm = TRUE),
    GPP_s1_annual = sum(GPP_s1, na.rm = TRUE),
    GPP_s2_annual = sum(GPP_s2, na.rm = TRUE),
    GPP_s3_annual = sum(GPP_s3, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    delta_s1_abs = GPP_s1_annual - GPP_baseline_annual,
    delta_s2_abs = GPP_s2_annual - GPP_baseline_annual,
    delta_s3_abs = GPP_s3_annual - GPP_baseline_annual,

    delta_s1_pct = (delta_s1_abs / GPP_baseline_annual) * 100,
    delta_s2_pct = (delta_s2_abs / GPP_baseline_annual) * 100,
    delta_s3_pct = (delta_s3_abs / GPP_baseline_annual) * 100
  )

site_summary <- annual_summary %>%
  group_by(site, aridity_class) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_delta_s1_pct = round(mean(delta_s1_pct, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    mean_delta_s2_pct = round(mean(delta_s2_pct, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    mean_delta_s3_pct = round(mean(delta_s3_pct, na.rm = TRUE), 2),

    mean_delta_s1_abs = round(mean(delta_s1_abs, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    mean_delta_s2_abs = round(mean(delta_s2_abs, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    mean_delta_s3_abs = round(mean(delta_s3_abs, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(mean_delta_s3_pct)

print(site_summary)
```

```{r}
scenario_colours <- c(
  "Mean VPD shift" = "#CCBB44",
  "+28% extreme magnitude" = "#EE6677",
  "Combined" = "#4477AA"
)

scenario_levels <- c(
  "Mean VPD shift",
  "+28% extreme magnitude",
  "Combined"
)

aridity_levels <- c(
  "Humid",
  "Dry sub-humid",
  "Semi-Arid",
  "Arid"
)

make_plot_df <- function(data, pct_or_abs) {

  if (pct_or_abs == "pct") {

    data %>%
      pivot_longer(
        cols = c(mean_delta_s1_pct, mean_delta_s2_pct, mean_delta_s3_pct),
        names_to = "scenario",
        values_to = "delta"
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        scenario = recode(
          scenario,
          mean_delta_s1_pct = "Mean VPD shift",
          mean_delta_s2_pct = "+28% extreme magnitude",
          mean_delta_s3_pct = "Combined"
        )
      )

  } else {

    data %>%
      pivot_longer(
        cols = c(mean_delta_s1_abs, mean_delta_s2_abs, mean_delta_s3_abs),
        names_to = "scenario",
        values_to = "delta"
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        scenario = recode(
          scenario,
          mean_delta_s1_abs = "Mean VPD shift",
          mean_delta_s2_abs = "+28% extreme magnitude",
          mean_delta_s3_abs = "Combined"
        )
      )
  }
}
```

```{r}
vpd_range_check <- map_dfr(names(prepared_envelope), function(s) {

  df <- prepared_envelope[[s]]

  vpd_shift <- case_when(
    s %in% humid_sites ~ aridity_vpd_shift["humid"],
    s %in% dry_subhumid_sites ~ aridity_vpd_shift["dry_subhumid"],
    s %in% semi_arid_sites ~ aridity_vpd_shift["semi_arid"],
    s %in% arid_sites ~ aridity_vpd_shift["arid"]
  )

  vpd_peak <- site_slopes %>%
    filter(site == s) %>%
    pull(vpd_at_peak)

  vpd_max_observed <- max(df$VPD, na.rm = TRUE)

  vpd_s1 <- df$VPD + vpd_shift

  vpd_s2 <- ifelse(
    df$VPD >= vpd_peak,
    df$VPD * 1.28,
    df$VPD
  )

  vpd_peak_shifted <- vpd_peak + vpd_shift

  vpd_s3_step1 <- df$VPD + vpd_shift

  vpd_s3 <- ifelse(
    vpd_s3_step1 >= vpd_peak_shifted,
    vpd_s3_step1 * 1.28,
    vpd_s3_step1
  )

  data.frame(
    site = s,
    vpd_peak_threshold = round(vpd_peak, 3),
    vpd_max_observed = round(vpd_max_observed, 3),
    vpd_max_s1 = round(max(vpd_s1, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    vpd_max_s2 = round(max(vpd_s2, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    vpd_max_s3 = round(max(vpd_s3, na.rm = TRUE), 3)
  )
})

print(vpd_range_check)
```
```{r}
# ── Percentage change plot ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
plot_df_pct <- make_plot_df(site_summary, "pct")

plot_df_pct$scenario <- factor(
  plot_df_pct$scenario,
  levels = scenario_levels
)

plot_df_pct$aridity_class <- factor(
  plot_df_pct$aridity_class,
  levels = aridity_levels
)

ggplot(plot_df_pct,
       aes(x = reorder(site, delta),
           y = delta,
           fill = scenario)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)) +
  facet_wrap(~ aridity_class, scales = "free_x", nrow = 1) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = scenario_colours) +
  labs(
    x = "Site",
    y = "Mean % change in annual GPP",
    fill = "Scenario"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.position = "top"
  )
```

# ── Wet-to-dry order ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
wet_to_dry_order <- c("Fog", "How", "Tum", "Wom", "Ade", "Cum", "Dap",
                      "Boy", "Das", "Dry", "Gin", "Rdf", "Rig", "Stp", "Whr",
                      "Asm")

# ── Aridity label helper for faceted boxplots ────────────────────────────────
aridity_label_df <- data.frame(
  aridity_class = aridity_levels,
  y             = Inf
) %>%
  mutate(aridity_class = factor(aridity_class, levels = aridity_levels))

# ── PLOT 1: Mean % GPP change per site ───────────────────────────────────────
p_pct <- make_plot_df(site_summary, "pct") %>%
  mutate(
    scenario = factor(scenario, levels = scenario_levels),
    site     = factor(site, levels = wet_to_dry_order)
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = site, y = delta, fill = scenario)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7, alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey30") +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = scenario_colours) +
  labs(
    title    = "Projected GPP change under future VPD scenarios",
    subtitle = "Mean annual % change vs baseline predicted GPP",
    x        = "Site (Wet to Dry)",
    y        = "Mean annual ΔGPP (%)",
    fill     = "Scenario"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
    plot.subtitle   = element_text(colour = "grey40", size = 10),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

# ── PLOT 2: Mean absolute GPP change per site ────────────────────────────────
p_abs <- make_plot_df(site_summary, "abs") %>%
  mutate(
    scenario = factor(scenario, levels = scenario_levels),
    site     = factor(site, levels = wet_to_dry_order)
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = site, y = delta, fill = scenario)) +

  ) +

p_aridity_pct <- annual_summary %>%

```{r}
# ── Hardcoded sensitivity order — most negative slope first to least
sensitivity_order <- c(
  "Fog", "Ade", "Dap", "Rdf", "Das", "Asm", "How", "Dry",
  "Rig", "Ync", "Stp", "Emr", "Gin", "Cpr", "Boy", "Wac",
  "Wom", "Whr", "Cum", "Gww", "Tum"
)

# ── PLOT 1: Mean % GPP change per site — sensitivity order ────────────────
p_pct_sensitivity <- make_plot_df(site_summary, "pct") %>%
  mutate(
    scenario = factor(scenario, levels = scenario_levels),
    site     = factor(site, levels = rev(sensitivity_order)) # reversed for steepest first
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(site)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = site, y = delta, fill = scenario)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7, alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey30") +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = scenario_colours) +
  labs(
    title    = "Projected GPP change under future VPD scenarios",
    subtitle = "Sites ordered from highest to lowest GPP–VPD sensitivity (Fog = steepest slope)",
    x        = "Site (Low to High Sensitivity)",
    y        = "Mean annual ΔGPP (%)",
    fill     = "Scenario"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
    plot.subtitle   = element_text(colour = "grey40", size = 10),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

# ── PLOT 2: Mean absolute GPP change per site — sensitivity order ─────────
p_abs_sensitivity <- make_plot_df(site_summary, "abs") %>%
  mutate(
    scenario = factor(scenario, levels = scenario_levels),
    site     = factor(site, levels = rev(sensitivity_order))
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(site)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = site, y = delta, fill = scenario)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7, alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey30") +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = scenario_colours) +
  labs(
    title    = "Projected GPP change under future VPD scenarios",
    subtitle = "Sites ordered from highest to lowest GPP–VPD sensitivity (Fog = steepest slope)",
    x        = "Site (Low to High Sensitivity)",
    y        = expression(Mean ~ annual ~ Delta*GPP ~ (g ~ C ~ m^{-2} ~ yr^{-1})),
    fill     = "Scenario"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
    plot.subtitle   = element_text(colour = "grey40", size = 10),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

# ── Print plots ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
print(p_pct_sensitivity)
print(p_abs_sensitivity)
```
